claim: Most computer interaction uses gestures and natural speech.
originalWording: Most computer interaction uses gestures and natural speech.

sources.title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil
sources.locator: Computers and communications in 2019: keyboards and interaction

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Gestures and natural spoken interaction predominate and keyboards become rare, retaining the substantive keyboard-rarity clause.
reference.rationale: Touchscreens and assistants were widespread by 2019, but keyboards remained normal. Multimodal AI expands the predicted interface, yet physical and on-screen keyboards are not rare. The compound remains partial.

evidence.title: Apple launches iPhone 4S, iOS 5 and iCloud
